Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the target 'deoxynucleoside triphosphate triphosphohydrolase' in assays performed on human cells. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for 'deoxynucleoside triphosphate triphosphohydrolase' and assays.assay_organism for 'Homo sapiens'. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return columns named molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
